data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2020 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were $466.959m. During 2020 management recorded a gross prioryear movement (increase) of $63.984m (13.7% of opening gross reserves), indicating an overall reserve strengthening. Management also references detailed Q4 2020 reserve reviews and specific favourable improvements to some closed years (notably 2018), and attributes changes to claims development, re-evaluation of IBNR and reinsurance recoveries, while many 2020 catastrophe events (hurricanes, Beirut explosion, US Derecho, Californian wildfires) and aviation losses influenced underwriting and reinsurance placements.

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary amounts are reported in the report currency (USD) and converted from $'000 to millions by dividing by 1,000. Field names include '_gbp_m' per requested schema but values are in USD millions (native currency). There is some contradictory narrative (management describes 'favourable improvement' in certain closed years such as 2018) while the Technical Provisions movement line shows a gross prior year increase of $63.984k (strengthening) for 2020; the numeric movement from the 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross column) has been used as the authoritative prior year development figure.
